title: Slushie Bar Salts Fizzy Cherry 10ml E-Liquid
description: Fizzy Cherry by Slushie Bar Salts is a tantalizing e-liquid that captures the classic taste of Cherries with a playful fizzy sensation, creating a unique and delightful vape experience. Each inhale is a journey into the world of sweet, yet slightly tart Cherry flavours, reminiscent of a refreshing Cherry soda or sugary Cherry sweet laced with sherbet. The e-liquid's effervescence adds a new dimension to the Cherry flavour, mimicking the sensation of sipping on a fizzy Cherry drink. The combination of sweetness and tartness is perfectly balanced, ensuring each puff is both satisfying and invigorating. The fizzy element provides a light, refreshing finish, making Fizzy Cherry a standout choice for those who love fruit flavours with a creative twist. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend hits the sweet spot between flavour and cloud production and the unique nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter kits and pod devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts. If you enjoy this flavour, there are plenty more Slushie Bar Salts flavours to try. Few e-liquid makers have mastered the icy joys of slushy flavours quite like Slushie, a UK company who are behind an irresistible line of 50ml and 100ml shortfill and Nic Salts e-liquids that blend mouth-watering fruit flavours with healthy doses of icy menthol for an unparalleled slushy vaping experience. We’re also thrilled to stock Slushy Bar Salts: Nic Salt e-liquids that capture the intense flavour and satisfaction of your favourite disposable vape flavours in handy 10ml bottles for use with a wide variety of MTL (mouth-to-lung) vape kits.
